_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior masonry wall coating (brick, CMU, cast concrete, limestone). Context prefix MSRY (MaSonRY) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD). Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). Block filler module conditional on CMU substrate.

paintable_items.name: Exterior masonry wall field surface
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for exterior masonry wall field. Covers brick, CMU, cast concrete, and limestone wall surfaces. SF-based — net paintable masonry area from PaintScope. Substrate_type modifier (brick/CMU/concrete/limestone) adjusts production rate and material requirements.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD. MSRY is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_MSRY_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_MSRY_WATER_WASH, TSK_MSRY_EFFLORESCENCE_TREAT, TSK_MSRY_BLOCK_FILL_SPRAY, TSK_MSRY_PRIME_SPRAY_BACKROLL, TSK_MSRY_FINISH_SPRAY_BACKROLL_1, TSK_MSRY_MOISTURE_TEST

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, HVAC, light fixtures
Cure verification, moisture testing, water wash, efflorescence treatment (conditional), form-release removal (concrete only), caulk masonry-to-trim joints
Block filler application — CMU only (PCA P12). Separate module from prep because it is a distinct material/application step. Spray or heavy roller.
Alkali-resistant primer (mandatory on all new masonry). Spray_backroll, roll, or brush.
First finish coat — acrylic or elastomeric per coating_system dimension.
Intercoat inspection. Light sand at QT4 only. Dust removal.
Second finish coat. QT2 may skip (single coat acceptable on properly primed surface).

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable masonry wall field area (square feet)
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Masonry substrate type (brick, CMU, concrete, limestone). Drives block filler requirement (CMU only), cleaning restrictions (no acid on limestone), breathability requirements.
paintscope_keys.notes: Per-elevation or per-wall section if mixed masonry types on same structure.

paintscope_keys.description: Masonry coating system (acrylic, elastomeric). Drives DFT, material consumption, production rate, and moisture risk assessment.
paintscope_keys.notes: Project-level configuration. Elastomeric selection triggers moisture source assessment documentation requirement.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of house perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection.
Count of exterior light fixtures to mask
Count of HVAC condenser units to cover

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — not applicable to masonry wall field. QT2 is economy (single finish coat on primed surface). All tiers require alkali-resistant primer on new masonry.

application_method.notes: Spray_backroll is gold standard for masonry — spray auto-adds backroll (mandatory per Exterior Application Methods Doctrine Part A §6). Spray-only is PROHIBITED on porous masonry. Roll is fallback for smaller areas or occupied-adjacent. Brush is detail work only.

sheen.notes: Standard exterior masonry sheens. Satin is most common (hides surface irregularities while providing durability). Flat for budget. Semi-gloss not typical for masonry wall field.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. Block filler module uses 'prep' phase (substrate preparation, not primer). No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for masonry wall field. EA for protection items. LF for caulk joints and landscape perimeter. FIXED for cure verification, moisture testing, tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY is the single NC state. All new masonry arrives bare — no factory-primed masonry exists. Output varies by sheen. SS_EXT_BARE_MASONRY is a proposed addition to controlled_enums.json.

product_role.notes: Specialty for block filler (not a primer — fills voids). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Exterior zones. Protection level upgrades by application method (roll < spray_backroll).

surface_ids.notes: masonry_wall_field is proposed — new surface ID for masonry wall. All adjacent surfaces exist in id_registry → surface_ids → entries_in_active_use.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ALKALI — same alkali-resistant primer concept for fiber cement. Could potentially share but masonry has different coverage rates and substrate context.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — same acrylic exterior finish product tier but different substrate context.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — same premium product tier but different substrate context.

proposed_systems.name: Block Filler for CMU (PCA P12)
proposed_systems.notes: Mandatory for CMU substrate. High-build block filler to fill voids (PCA P12 Level 2 Standard Fill). Not a primer — substrate preparation product. Heavy-body material requiring 527-535 tip and 30-mesh filter.

proposed_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer
proposed_systems.notes: Mandatory on ALL new masonry (pH 12-14). Reference product: SW Loxon Masonry Primer (rated to pH 13). Allows 7-day accelerated coating vs 28-day standard cure. Standard acrylic primer NOT suitable.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior latex. 10-20 perms breathability. 6-8 mils DFT. QT2 single coat, QT3 two coats.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
proposed_systems.notes: Premium 100% acrylic (SW Duration, BM Aura). 10-20 perms. Raking light inspection between coats. Two coats standard.

proposed_systems.name: Elastomeric Coating for Masonry
proposed_systems.notes: Elastomeric coating: 5-15 perms, 20-30 mils DFT, 300-500% elongation. Bridges hairline cracks. WARNING: high risk of catastrophic delamination if moisture enters from alternate sources. Requires moisture source assessment. Not available at QT2 (application complexity exceeds economy scope). Dramatically higher material consumption than acrylic.

material_system_prefix.notes: 1 block filler (CMU only) + 1 alkali-resistant primer (all masonry) + 2 acrylic finish (QT2-3, QT4) + 1 elastomeric finish (QT3-4 conditional). Oil-based and alkyd products are PROHIBITED on alkaline masonry.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 inch nap (masonry)
proposed_consumables.notes: Heavy nap roller for porous/rough masonry surfaces. Nylon/polyester blend for water-based products. Much thicker nap than interior or siding rollers.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (masonry acrylic)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.017 orifice for standard acrylic latex on masonry. Also 619, 621 for wider patterns.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 531 (block filler/elastomeric)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.025-0.035 orifice for heavy-body block fillers and elastomeric coatings. 527, 531, 535 range. Requires 2,300-3,000 PSI.

proposed_consumables.name: 60-Mesh Spray Filter (Black) for Latex
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 60-mesh (black/medium) filter for acrylic latex exterior coatings.

proposed_consumables.name: 30-Mesh Spray Filter (Gray/Coarse) for Block Filler
proposed_consumables.notes: Coarse 30-mesh (gray) filter for block fillers and elastomeric coatings — heavy-body materials clog standard 60-mesh filters.

proposed_consumables.name: Red Stucco Poly Tape (7.0 mil, 30-day UV)
proposed_consumables.notes: Masking tape for rough masonry/stucco surfaces. Standard blue tape will not adhere to textured masonry. 7.0 mil thickness, 30-day UV rating for exterior.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting for Exterior Protection
proposed_consumables.notes: 4 mil minimum. Landscape, hardscape, HVAC overspray protection. UV-resistant for multi-day exterior projects.

proposed_consumables.name: Polyurethane Exterior Caulk (Class 25/50)
proposed_consumables.notes: Polyurethane caulk for masonry-to-trim joints. 3-7 day cure before painting. Siliconized acrylic acceptable for low-movement joints.

proposed_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
proposed_consumables.notes: For masonry washing (moderate efflorescence, general cleaning). Box or container — 1 EA per ~500 SF wash area.

proposed_consumables.name: Stiff Bristle Masonry Brush
proposed_consumables.notes: For efflorescence removal, masonry scrubbing, and prep. Heavy-duty bristle brush.

proposed_configurations.description: Block filler + 1 alkali-resistant primer + 2 finish coats — CMU at QT3/QT4
Block filler + 1 primer + 1 finish coat — CMU at QT2
1 alkali-resistant primer + 2 finish coats — brick/concrete/limestone at QT3/QT4
1 primer + 1 finish coat — brick/concrete/limestone at QT2

proposed_profiles.description: Block filler coverage on CMU — 75-125 SF/gal depending on void density
Alkali-resistant primer on bare masonry — 250-350 SF/gal. Smooth brick higher, textured CMU lower.
Acrylic finish on primed masonry — 300-350 SF/gal smooth, 150-250 SF/gal textured/porous
Elastomeric finish on primed masonry — dramatically lower coverage due to 20-30 mil DFT requirement. Estimated 75-150 SF/gal.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility. Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate spec scopes. No cross-spec flags needed at this time.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by masonry substrate type
proposed_modifiers.notes: Brick is baseline (dense, relatively smooth). CMU slower due to porous surface and voids. Concrete slightly faster (smooth formed surface). Limestone slower (porous, acid-sensitivity requires care).

materials_json.oil_based_blocker: Oil-based and alkyd products are PROHIBITED on alkaline masonry. Include as compatibility_rule blocker.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_MSRY_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_MASONRY_WALL MUST be used exactly as registered (proposed ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Masonry Wall Coating (Brick, CMU, Concrete, Limestone)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior masonry wall coating. Distinct substrate chemistry (cementitious, pH 12-14), unique prep requirements (block filler, efflorescence treatment, cure verification), specialized primer (alkali-resistant), and dual coating system branches (acrylic, elastomeric).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior masonry wall field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM covers exterior masonry wall surfaces. ITM_SIDING_FIELD is for siding (wood, fiber cement). Masonry is a fundamentally different substrate class with distinct UOM patterns and production characteristics.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior masonry wall field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New surface vocabulary entry. No existing surface_id covers masonry wall field. Similar naming pattern to siding_field.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Landscape perimeter protection zone (LF-based)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: EXISTING in fiber cement spec — confirm registry addition. LF-based landscape protection measured along house perimeter.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bare new masonry (pH 12-14, alkaline)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New masonry-specific bare state. Distinct from SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD and SS_EXT_BARE_FIBERCEMENT — masonry has unique alkalinity, porosity, and cure requirements. Required for primer routing (alkali-resistant primer mandatory).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Wall Field Surface Area (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for masonry wall net paintable area. Distinct from PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.SIDING_FIELD — masonry is a different measurement context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Wall Field Area Input (SF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_SURFACE_SF.MASONRY_WALL.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Substrate Type Enum (brick/CMU/concrete/limestone)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for masonry substrate type selection. Drives block filler requirement, cleaning restrictions, and breathability requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Substrate Type Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_TYPE_MASONRY.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Coating System Enum (acrylic/elastomeric)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New PS key for masonry coating system selection. Drives DFT, material consumption, production rate, and moisture risk.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Masonry Coating System Input (ENUM)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.COATING_SYSTEM_MASONRY.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Block Filler for CMU (PCA P12)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers CMU block filler. Unique material — fills voids, not a primer. Heavy-body product with distinct application requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Masonry Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: SYS_EXT_FC_PRIMER_ALKALI covers fiber cement alkali primer. Masonry has different coverage rates (more porous), different substrate chemistry, and different application context. Separate system for accurate coverage tracking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Masonry-specific finish system. Different coverage rates from wood siding (masonry is more porous). QT2/QT3 tier.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Finish for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4 masonry finish. Premium products (SW Duration, BM Aura). Different coverage context from siding.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Elastomeric Coating for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers elastomeric coatings. Unique product class: 20-30 mil DFT, 300-500% elongation, dramatically different coverage and production rates. Conditional on coating_system dimension.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Block Filler Coverage Profile for CMU
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Block filler coverage is unique — 75-125 SF/gal depending on void density. No existing COV_ covers this.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer Coverage Profile for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Masonry primer coverage differs from fiber cement (more porous substrate). 250-350 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Finish Coverage Profile for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Masonry finish coverage: 300-350 SF/gal smooth, 150-250 SF/gal textured/porous. Significantly different from siding.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Elastomeric Finish Coverage Profile for Masonry
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Elastomeric coverage dramatically lower due to 20-30 mil DFT. Estimated 75-150 SF/gal. No existing COV_ covers this product class.
